title: [ORION-QG QG-32c] Independent exact MITM replication of four-probe infeasibility
body:
Parent programme: #740.
Earned parent: QG-32 #911 (certified fixed five-probe upper bound only).
Primary candidate under replication: QG-32b #918 / draft PR #919. Its production depth-4 search returned NO for <=4, but the prospectively frozen independent MILP timed out; therefore **QG-32b has no exact fixed-minimum authority**.

## Status

**POST-RESULT INDEPENDENT REPLICATION. FREEZE COMPLETE BEFORE QG-32c EXECUTION.**

The visible primary candidate is explicitly not treated as authority. QG-32c independently reconstructs the QG-32 observation problem from the already-earned generic primitives and decides whether any <=4 fixed indexed-probe separator exists.

Frozen method: exact 2+2 meet-in-the-middle. Enumerate every unique coverage union reachable with 0/1/2 nondominated probe classes. A <=4 cover exists iff two half-unions cover all 5,895 unresolved pairs. No QG-32b production code, artifact, memo table, branching order, or witness may be read by the solver.

Allowed terminals:
- `QG32C_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION_CONFIRMS_NO_FOUR_PROBE_SEPARATOR`
- `QG32C_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION_FINDS_FOUR_OR_FEWER_SEPARATOR`
- `QG32C_CANNOT_CHECK`

A separate generic verifier rebuilds the half-union family with different ordering/filter logic; native ORION-Q gates only fixed indexed-identity authority. Deterministic replay and self-consistent semantic tamper rejection are mandatory.

If and only if QG-32c independently returns NO with all gates GREEN, its lower bound >=5 may be combined with QG-32's already-earned five-probe upper bound to authorize exact fixed minimum 5 for the indexed local-response identity query after the frozen joint bulk+spectrum summaries.

Always false: adaptive-tree optimality (QG-34 separate), full finite-n optimum probes, hardware/measurement minimum, QG-28 global state minimality, novelty authority, physical quantum advantage.

Frozen protocol: `development/orion-qg-regime-geometry/QG32C_INDEPENDENT_MITM_REPLICATION_PROTOCOL_V1.md`.

nodes.body:
Protected QG-32c replication is GREEN end-to-end. Exact independent MITM result: `EXISTS_SEPARATOR_AT_MOST_4=false` over the reconstructed 715 orbits / 384 probes / 92 joint classes / 5,895 unresolved pairs. Production enumerated 14,181 unique 0/1/2-probe half-unions and found no completing 2+2 pair; the independent verifier regenerated the same decision with a different ordering/filter path and tested 111,551,060 exact candidate completions. Native gate, deterministic replay, and self-consistent semantic tamper rejection all passed.

Therefore, combining this independently replicated lower bound `minimum >= 5` with QG-32's already-earned five-probe separator, the **exact fixed indexed-probe minimum is 5** for recovering the 715-way indexed local-response identity after the frozen joint bulk+spectrum summaries.

Scope remains hard-bounded: no adaptive-tree optimality (QG-34 separate), no full finite-n optimum, no hardware measurement minimum, no global-state minimality, no novelty or physical quantum-advantage authority. Sealed files: `research/extensions/orion-qg/QG32C_MITM_REPLICATION_RESULTS.json` and `development/orion-qg-regime-geometry/QG32C_PROTECTED_RUN_RECEIPT_2026-08-22.json`.

**Retraction notice (now on main via #926).** The headline this issue builds on is null-reproducible: the separation counts (`85/92`, `708/715`, `D_*=3 < F_*=4 < U_*=5`, the regret curve) are reproduced by a row-shuffle null, and `85 = 92−7` / `708 = 715−7` are identities forced by the class-size histogram frozen before any solver ran. See `development/orion-qg-regime-geometry/QG_RETRACTION_SELECTION_HEADLINES_V1.md` and `QG_ADVERSARIAL_REFEREE_REPORT.md`. What survives: C1(b) descriptor completeness (whose ceiling theorem is Lehmann 1959 per the lane's own prior-art audit), witness disjointness, and the depth-3 residual (16 classes / 168 masks vs null-A mean 8.9 / 384 — noting null B in the residual script is uninformative by construction, being exactly permutation-invariant). Work on this issue should either retarget the surviving residual or close as superseded.
